prose: The Pentagon says overreliance on AI contributed to a missile strike on an Iranian school, according to a Bloomberg investigation. It's a landmark admission: a lethal targeting error formally attributed, at least in part, to trusting AI systems too much. (The article is paywalled; this summary is based on the headline and related coverage in the corpus.)
highlights: Pentagon: overreliance on AI contributed to a missile strike on an Iran school
A rare official attribution of a lethal error to AI overreliance
Bloomberg original is paywalled; summary from headline and related coverage
Directly relevant to the week's debates on agentic systems in military use
